title: Banks as Tax Planning Intermediaries

scopes.description: Full pipeline here is the supplied GGM_2018_code.sas data-construction workflow through the datasets it writes: Steps 1–16, including the actual CRSP/CCM step despite its comment that it is not used in the main analyses, LRC3 and UTB outputs, and both new-banking-relationship branches. The datasheet separately documents a third pairing panel and Appendix A9/A10 outputs that this source does not produce; these remain explicit conditional downstream gaps. The two shipped CSVs are identifier lists and do not justify an analysis-only path.

requirements.description: Compustat North America Fundamentals Annual panel used to build borrower-year tax outcomes and controls (D0003).

routes.description: Catalog-listed COMPA.FUNDA is readable with core gvkey/date/year/format and tax/accounting columns. Additional Compustat fields used by the program and sufficient historical coverage for the lag/rolling constructions have not been exhaustively checked.
routes.expected_period: The code filters LRC3 observations at fyear>=1993 and UTB at fyear>=2007. Upstream construction checks consecutive lags through ten prior years and uses rolling pre-period variables, so the source must retain the history those constructions use; the filters alone do not establish coverage.

requirements.description: Compustat domestic company identity/geography/industry fields joined to the annual panel (D0005).

routes.description: Catalog-listed COMPA.COMPANY is locally readable, and the bounded probe confirms every field requested here. The supplied code merges it by gvkey as a static identity/address/industry lookup, with no year filter.
routes.expected_period: Static identity, address and industry lookup joined by gvkey; the supplied code applies no year filter. The bounded probe confirms all requested columns.

requirements.description: Separate Compustat age/first-fiscal-year input used to add first_fyear by gvkey (D0006).

routes.description: COMPA.FUNDA is a product candidate with gvkey, fyear, datafmt and consol; the supplied code reads a separate `local.compage` dataset and no author producer or exact schema is supplied. Any derivation from the annual panel requires author confirmation of the intended first-year definition and full history.
routes.expected_period: Required history must support the author’s filtered/deduplicated first_fyear value for each gvkey. The exact start year, producer and first_fyear definition are not supplied.

requirements.description: CRSP/Compustat CCM link history used in the actual Step 3 branch (D0008).

routes.description: Catalog-listed CCMXPF_LINKTABLE is readable and exposes the used flag, gvkey, permno and link-date fields. Coverage of the full date range needed by the target Compustat datadates remains unverified.
routes.expected_period: Code applies usedflag and link-date/link-end-date conditions at Compustat datadates; preserve the required link history over all target firm-years.

requirements.description: CRSP daily stock-security file used for CUSIP-to-PERMNO mapping in the actual Step 3 branch (D0009).

routes.description: Catalog-listed CRSP.DSF is readable with CUSIP and PERMNO; code builds a de-duplicated CUSIP/security map. Coverage for all CUSIPs in the supplied annual panel remains unverified.
routes.expected_period: The code’s CUSIP mapping has no date filter, so the source must cover the CUSIPs used across all processed annual records; a bounded probe does not establish all-row coverage.

requirements.description: Dealscan facility amendment dates/maturity used to extend facility end dates (D0011).

routes.expected_period: Retain the amendment history needed for all target facilities and their code-derived start/end dates; complete coverage is unverified.

requirements.description: Dealscan lender-share/role/allocation data used to identify lead lenders and bank allocations (D0012).

software.name: SAS
software.description: The supplied entry point is SAS. The existing environment evidence names `sas_u8`, but bounded startup failed with a TKELS Launch Service Load Failure, so an observed runtime/version was not established. The artifact says this is not evidence of a missing license; no retry was made.

issues.description: The workflow reads `dropbox2.DealScan_Compustat_Link_Aug_12` at SAS line 114, but the supplied entry file defines only `lendlink`, `local`, and `dropbox`. The required include/autoexec setup, exact 2012 borrower-link file path and input contract are not supplied or specified. A catalog miss does not show that the WRDS product or license is absent.

At SAS line 828 the program sorts `temp9i_11_4` into `local.temp12`; a complete-source scan finds only this read and no producer for `temp9i_11_4`. Its schema and missing construction cannot be inferred safely, so the downstream Steps 11–12 branch cannot be closed.

The entry program includes `WT.sas`, described as the winsorization/truncation macro available upon request. The macro source, version and macro body are not in this package; its many calls are required for data construction.
The entry program includes `FF48.sas`, described as the Fama-French 48 industry-assignment macro available upon request, and invokes `%FF48_Ind` in Step 3. Its source and interface are not supplied.

Both new-banking-relationship branches filter on `abs(eventtime)<4` (SAS lines 1984 and 2218), but complete-source inspection finds no assignment or producer for `eventtime`. Its reference event, units, fiscal alignment and intended source must be clarified before either branch is closed.

The datasheet describes a third panel containing realized and potential bank-borrower pairs, but the supplied SAS source does not produce that panel; it ends with the LRC3 and UTB new-relationship outputs. The pairing-panel producer or exact author-prepared panel contract is missing. The two shipped CSVs are gvkey-only borrower lists and do not supply this panel.

Appendix A8–A9 describes tax-haven and SPE counts from Dyreng/SEC Exhibit 21, including the country/entity rules and missingness for pre-1997 or unextractable filings. The datasheet says supplemental count increases/indicators for new-relationship tests are available on request, but the supplied SAS contains no EX21/SPE construction or A9 driver. Keep this as a conditional downstream appendix requirement; request the author-supplied data/producer contract if A9 is in scope, without independently rebuilding it.

Appendix A10 uses whether management provides guidance, measured with IBES Guidance, but the supplied SAS contains no IBES/guidance construction or A10 driver. The local `IBES.DET_GUIDANCE` product is only a candidate; the firm-year mapping, classification rule and branch code are not supplied. Keep this conditional downstream and request the author contract if A10 is in scope.

The entry source hardcodes D: paths for the `lendlink`, `local` and `dropbox` librefs and for the `WT.sas` and `FF48.sas` includes. A local execution setup needs one consistent workspace path mapping for those roots and includes. The `dropbox2` borrower-link location remains unresolved under I001 and must be added to that same configuration only after its exact file path is confirmed.

review_notes: Scope boundary: full_pipeline assesses the supplied GGM_2018_code.sas data-construction workflow through the datasets it writes, including Steps 1–16, the actual CRSP/CCM step despite its “not used in main analyses” comment, both LRC3/UTB branches, and both new-banking-relationship branches. The datasheet separately documents a third pair-choice panel and Appendix A9/A10 paths that this source does not produce; these remain explicit conditional downstream gaps.

No analysis_only scope is supported: the two packaged CSVs are one-column unique-gvkey lists, not analysis panels, and no supplied branch skips raw-data construction with a compatible full analysis input.

Catalog lookups covered both source products and exact author aliases. One-row SAS probes establish readability and requested columns for probed products; they do not establish historical coverage or population for time-varying panels. Those remaining period, key and construction checks are stated on the relevant routes. COMPA.COMPANY and DEALSCAN.COMPANY are supported local static lookups for the requested fields, joined respectively by gvkey and CompanyID with no year filter in the supplied code. Catalog/alias misses are not evidence that data or a license is absent.

The two independent bank annual sources `banks` and `banks_fs` remain separate requirements. COMP.BANK_FUNDA is a readable candidate for the annual interface; COMP.BANK_FUNDQ is quarterly and not a direct substitute; the exact author `banks_fs` producer remains unknown.

Local SEC raw/parsed roots were checked only for existence, and WRDSSEC.EXHIBITS was checked only as a one-row metadata product. No directory listing or broad filing scan was performed. The Dyreng author URL is named by the datasheet, but the direct page check did not establish current file delivery or coverage.

The SAS environment artifact reports a TKELS Launch Service Load Failure and marks SAS unverified. It explicitly does not establish a missing license; the prior bounded startup check/retry were reused without another retry.
